observations.behavior: Adds a new optional string field 'window' alongside the existing optional number field 'window_minutes' in HogQL workflow action types.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows HogQL workflows to specify a conversion window as a duration string rather than only as minutes, while retaining backward compatibility with the numeric minutes field.

observations.behavior: Adds a conversion window configuration section to the HogFlow editor, including a HogFlowDuration component and conversion window display.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a UI for users to configure the conversion window, with a tooltip explaining its purpose and a HogFlowDuration component for input.
